title: COMPUTE for Simple Business Math
learning_objectives: Track how numeric values are combined
Interpret the business meaning of a calculated result
snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. BONUSCALC.

       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 BASE-PAY     PIC 9(4) VALUE 2000.
       01 BONUS-RATE   PIC 9V99 VALUE 0.10.
       01 BONUS-AMOUNT PIC 9(4)V99.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           COMPUTE BONUS-AMOUNT = BASE-PAY * BONUS-RATE
           DISPLAY BONUS-AMOUNT
           STOP RUN.

practice_question.prompt: What is COMPUTE doing in this snippet?

choices.B: Calculating BONUS-AMOUNT from BASE-PAY and BONUS-RATE

timed_task.prompt: If BASE-PAY is 2000 and BONUS-RATE is 0.10, what result should BONUS-AMOUNT hold?

pre_test.prompt: Which COBOL statement is commonly used for arithmetic expressions?
What does multiplication do in a business formula?

choices.B: Combines numbers according to a factor or rate

post_test.prompt: Why is BONUS-RATE multiplied by BASE-PAY in this example?

choices.A: To calculate a percentage-based bonus amount

post_test.prompt: After the COMPUTE line, what does DISPLAY BONUS-AMOUNT do?
